bigIdeas.en: Number represents, describes, and compares the quantities of ratios, rates, and percents.
bigIdeas.zh: 比、比率和百分数所代表的量，都可以用数来表示、描述和比较。

bigIdeas.en: Computational fluency and flexibility extend to operations with fractions.
bigIdeas.zh: 运算的熟练和灵活，扩展到分数的运算。

bigIdeas.en: Discrete linear relationships can be represented in many connected ways and used to identify and make generalizations.
bigIdeas.zh: 离散的线性关系可以用多种相互关联的方式表示，用来发现规律、归纳一般结论。

bigIdeas.en: The relationship between surface area and volume of 3D objects can be used to describe, measure, and compare spatial relationships.
bigIdeas.zh: 立体图形的表面积与体积之间的关系，可以用来描述、测量和比较空间关系。

bigIdeas.en: Analyzing data by determining averages is one way to make sense of large data sets and enables us to compare and interpret.
bigIdeas.zh: 用平均数来分析数据，是理解大量数据的一种办法，便于比较和解读。
